description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Form 3CD clauses an SME tax audit works through, each shown only when it applies to this client: needs = every fact must hold, any = at least one. Facts come from the tagged statements (has_<item>), the client (status_<status>, partners) and the year (presumptive).
